requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed bottles supporting 6,000 pages for Black and CMY, and increase CMY bottle size to support over 8,000 pages yield.
requirements.Rationale: To meet higher page yield requirements and reduce frequency of bottle replacement, improving customer experience and cost efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle design changes and compatibility with existing and new ink systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles are available for Black and CMY, support at least 6K yield (Black and CMY), and CMY bottle size supports >8K yield as verified by lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new ink bottles provide spill-free reliability during handling, installation, and use.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize mess and customer complaints, and to differentiate from competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, NOA-F integration, manufacturing process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Less than 0.5% of bottle installations result in spills in controlled and field environments.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a NOA-F (Non-Ozone Air Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, without changing the click-on push-push and TDF (Tactile Feedback) mechanism.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain air management and filtration performance while ensuring backward compatibility with current mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F unit passes filtration, durability, and usability tests and is compatible with push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie Ink
requirements.Description: Reuse the SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie pigment inks without reformulation for the new product.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage existing investments, reduce risk, and speed up time to market.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility verification with new hardware and consumables.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA and Magi/Nessie inks function as intended in the new printer with no reformulation needed.

requirements.Title: Enhanced Reliability and Characterization Modeling
requirements.Description: Perform comprehensive reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS (Ink Delivery System) characterization and modeling, including startup and NOA-F end-of-life (EOL) scenarios.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust performance and longevity under diverse conditions.
requirements.Dependencies: Access to new hardware and consumable prototypes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All models and characterizations completed and reviewed by R&D, with results meeting internal reliability thresholds.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modeling for Tank Impact on Print Quality
requirements.Description: Model ink stability in the tank and assess its impact on print quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To prevent print quality degradation over time due to ink instability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Modeling completed and print quality remains within specified tolerances throughout expected tank life.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Part with Warranty Support
requirements.Description: Provide NOA-F as a service part available for warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure continued product functionality and customer satisfaction during and after warranty period.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F is available as a service part, and process documentation is in place for warranty claims.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 (presumed tracking or anti-counterfeit technology) on the lid of the new bottles or tanks.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance tracking, authentication, or anti-counterfeit measures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is present and operational on all lids as verified by QA.

requirements.Title: Modify Existing Factory Line SA14 for NOA-F
requirements.Description: Modify the existing SA14 factory line to support NOA-F production.
requirements.Rationale: To enable manufacturing of the new NOA-F units without building a new line.
requirements.Dependencies: Existing SA14 line capabilities, NOA-F design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 line is validated for NOA-F output with no significant downtime or yield loss.

requirements.Title: Add Magi Ink Cart and Labelling Tool in Orcus 5
requirements.Description: Integrate Magi ink cartridge and a new labeling tool into the Orcus 5 production line.
requirements.Rationale: To support new consumables and ensure accurate labeling for traceability and compliance.
requirements.Dependencies: Orcus 5 line capabilities, Magi ink cart design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Orcus 5 line produces correctly labeled Magi ink cartridges at required throughput.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design product so that both the Print Head Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F can be replaced by customers without technical assistance.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability, reduce downtime, and lower support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and NOA-F design, user documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F in under 10 minutes using only included tools, as verified in usability testing.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal: 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Set the new warranty page life goal for the product at 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase product value proposition and reduce total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation specifies 80K page life and all major components meet this target in reliability testing.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Adopt Reddington ID with a larger tank size, but no change to Marconi-HI ADF (Automatic Document Feeder).
requirements.Rationale: To accommodate increased ink volume and support higher page yields without impacting ADF.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New tank fits within product ID and does not interfere with ADF operation; tank size increase validated in design review.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS (Expanded Polystyrene) foam packaging for the new printer.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure product protection during shipping and handling, and potentially align with EPEAT3 and LOT4 requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All shipped units use EPS foam packaging, and packaging passes drop and vibration tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Certification for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the PDL SKU meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: To comply with environmental standards and enhance product marketability in regulated regions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel prior to product launch.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate the new tank's protrusion and optimize overall product size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure paper handling is not impacted by the increased tank size and to maintain compactness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays accommodate tank protrusion with no paper jams or misfeeds in reliability testing.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphics Display) for user interface.
requirements.Rationale: To provide a modern, user-friendly interface for configuration and operation.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Product Management, UI/UX Team
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All units ship with functional 4.3” CGD display and pass usability tests.

requirements.Title: Leverage Sayan Sibstar Tubes with New Routing
requirements.Description: Use Sayan Sibstar tubes and implement new tube routing and integration for the platform.
requirements.Rationale: To optimize ink delivery and support new tank and bottle configurations.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube design, tank and carriage integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New routing supports reliable ink delivery and passes stress and durability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management with Tank Changes
requirements.Description: Update service station aerosol management systems to accommodate spit platform changes due to the new tank.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain air quality and prevent ink misting issues with the new tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system passes air quality and containment tests with new tank configuration.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased component weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure mechanical reliability and print quality with the new hardware configuration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within force and speed specifications in all test scenarios with new configuration.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Upgrade for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Upgrade the printer paper path to support the increased page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure consistent performance and reliability over the extended life cycle.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components meet or exceed 80K page life in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post 80K Life
requirements.Description: Make ink maintenance a serviceable part at service centers after the printer reaches 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To extend printer usability and support post-warranty maintenance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance parts for printers beyond 80K page life.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement a new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection for the Ink Delivery System (IDS), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure secure and reliable ink connections with new tank and bottle designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All IDS connections meet leak, durability, and usability standards in lab and field tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm and air management system for the IDS to accommodate new hardware and consumables.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure reliable printer startup and ink delivery with new configurations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer starts up reliably and air management maintains ink flow integrity in all tested scenarios.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Definition
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and define depletion criteria to match the new page yield definition.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure print quality remains high throughout the extended yield and is clearly defined for warranty and support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion criteria are documented and met in all production units.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse the Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the new printer.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven components and reduce development time and cost.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All reused components function correctly in new printer configuration.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate the Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: To provide modern wireless features and maintain competitive parity.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All printers support wireless connectivity with Stingray module and pass connectivity tests.

requirements.Title: Dune Firmware Platform
requirements.Description: Utilize the Dune firmware platform for printer operation.
requirements.Rationale: To standardize firmware across new products and leverage existing development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer operates on Dune firmware platform with all required features enabled.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: To enhance product security and protect against threats.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All printers pass security certification and vulnerability testing for Gauss4.xx.

requirements.Title: Business Model Support: Consumer, SMB, Enterprise
requirements.Description: Support multiple business models including Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise, with tailored services and solutions.
requirements.Rationale: To maximize addressable market and provide value to different customer segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Solution and service integration, pricing models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product and services are available for all three segments with appropriate features and support.

requirements.Title: Solution Integration: Scan, SMB Manageability, Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: To meet the needs of business customers and enhance solution offerings.
requirements.Stakeholders: Enterprise Customers, SMBs, Product Management, IT
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed solutions are available and functional at launch.

requirements.Title: Client and Driver Support: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility with HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: To provide broad compatibility for deployment and management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All drivers and clients are available and pass certification with the new printer.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence
requirements.Description: Meet the defined development and production schedule as outlined (Q3'25 to Q4'27).
requirements.Rationale: To achieve timely market entry and meet business objectives.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All major milestones are met per the published schedule.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp Print Head Assembly (PHA) achieves a minimum life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To deliver reliable print performance and meet service expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA meets or exceeds 65K page life in accelerated life tests.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years or 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: To provide clear customer assurance and align with product durability goals.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation and support processes are aligned with this policy.

requirements.Title: Throughput: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Ensure print throughput of 25/20 pages per minute (ppm), and 25/19 ppm for PDL (Page Description Language) SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To meet market expectations for print speed and maintain competitiveness.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printers achieve specified ppm rates in standardized print speed tests.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design product for easy maintenance box replacement to improve serviceability.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize downtime and enable user or technician servicing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced in under 5 minutes by trained personnel or users.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Integration
requirements.Description: Provide solutions tailored for Small and Medium Business (SMB) needs.
requirements.Rationale: To increase adoption and satisfaction in the SMB market segment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB-specific solutions are available and functional at launch.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Printing as a Service) Enablement
requirements.Description: Enable Printing as a Service (PaaS) offering for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: To address evolving business models and customer preferences for service-based offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS is available for the printer at launch with all core features enabled.
